name: smh_pvm_ref_r4-r1-COMMIT
purpose: HF-5 rp4a blocker: ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge (PUBLISH 1, LV 4, TAGW 16: real 64x512 1R1W stack macro + 16 LAT-7 RNE FP32 adders + publication / fold) gets its own hard view (smh_pvm) for the attn leaf band of rp4a. New element, no prior view. Recipe 4 (pin registers at every data pin, +1 cycle per input and per output, absorbed by the static calendar; die hold budget). Macro W-face pins (rd_out / wd) face the logic band; inputs from sum_capture on N, merged node on S, publication / fold control on W.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge #(.TAGW(16), .LV(4), .PUBLISH(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/gpu/ot_gpu_fadd.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v rtl/hbm_accel/sm/attn/ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge.sv && echo lint-ok
